xBRIEFInfo.description: Sidebar count of actors missing photos

plan.title: Sidebar should count actors missing a photo, mirroring the unreviewed-videos badge

narratives.Overview: All Assets shows a count of unreviewed videos. Actors should show a comparable count of actors missing a photo.
narratives.Problem: There is no at-a-glance signal of how much actor data is incomplete, so the gap is invisible until someone goes looking.
narratives.Action: Mirror the existing unreviewed-videos badge exactly - same placement, same styling. This is a consistency fix, not a new pattern.
narratives.Constraint: Must be federation-aware: with several libraries attached the sidebar shows a union, and the count has to match. The count must be computed, never assumed - a recent enrichment run filled 137 photo URLs, so the live number has moved.
narratives.Test: T7 - correct with zero missing, with some, and across attached libraries.
narratives.Source: Spec R3. Consider whether tapping applies the missing-photo filter, and whether it should count 'actors needing attention' (R7) instead.

items.title: Decide whether tapping applies the filter
